summary_1line: Valmiki, moved by a hunter killing a bird, spontaneously utters the first metrical verse; Brahma then commands him to compose the epic of Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: A hidden hunter shoots a male krauncha bird while it mates, as the grieving female cries beside the fallen body before the shocked sage Valmiki.
Valmiki stands by the clear Tamasa River with disciple Bharadwaja, raising his hand in sorrow as he utters the first poetic curse.
The four-faced god Brahma appears radiantly in Valmiki’s forest hermitage, blessing the sage and commanding him to compose the story of Rama.
